title: Fayil ɗin UX ɗin ku, nazarin shari'a da shirin kwanaki 90

say: Fayil ɗin UX ɗin ku, nazarin shari'a da shirin kwanaki 90.
Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar 4 na UX Design Fundamentals.
Kun riga kuna da sassan aikin UX na gaske: tambayoyi, mutum, kwarara, firam ɗin waya, bita da sakamakon gwaji.
Da farko za ku haɗa su a cikin fakitin bincike ɗaya, tare da lambobin mahalarta, ba sunaye ba.

say: Misali, samfurin salon salon Blessing na ƙarshe yana da fuska 6, gami da ramin da aka ɗauka kawai da allon gazawar biyan kuɗi. Ta sake gwadawa tare da abokan ciniki 3, kuma duk 3 sun kammala booking.
Fakitin bincikenta PDF ne mai shafuka 14 tare da hanyar haɗi zuwa samfurin.
Kafin kayi sallama, duba waɗannan maki biyar, sannan ka buɗe hanyar haɗin yanar gizon ku ta hanyar sharewa akan wayar wani don tabbatar da tana aiki.

say: Masu daukan ma'aikata suna neman yadda kuke tunani, ba kawai allon da aka gama ba. Fara da wanda yayi gwagwarmaya da menene, sannan faɗi abin da kuka yi da kanku da iyakokinku, kamar kasafin kuɗi, na'urori ko bayanai.

panel.rule: Ku kiyaye gaskiya iri ɗaya. Canza abin da kuke jagoranta da shi kawai.

say: Albarka ta rubuta budi uku. Don aikin hukumar ƙira, ta kan jagoranci tare da hanyoyin bincikenta da abubuwan da ta ke yi.

cards.d: Jagoranci tare da tsari: tambayoyi shida, zagaye na gwaji biyu, nasara daga 3 na 5 zuwa 5 na 5.
Jagoranci tare da kasuwanci: yanke lokacin yin rajista daga kusan 95 zuwa kusan daƙiƙa 48.
Jagoranci tare da wanda aka taimaka: an gwada shi tare da tsofaffin abokan ciniki da masu amfani da wayoyin zamani na farko.

Na farko, an gwada aikin na biyu tare da masu amfani 5.

say: Don tunawa. Nuna shaidar ku. Yaren mutanen Poland kawai abin da aka gwada. Faɗa wa labari bayyananne, gaskiya ga kowane mai karatu. Don samun takardar shedar ku, kammala babban dutse kuma ku ci aƙalla kashi 70 a cikin tambayoyin ƙarshe.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Fakitin bincike yana nuna shaidar da ke bayan yanke shawara
Zane na gani kawai bayan an gwada tsarin
Matsala, rawar, bincike, ƙira, sakamako

Maki aƙalla kashi 70 cikin ɗari a jarabawar ƙarshe

say: Juyin ku. Gina fakitin ku, rubuta binciken shari'ar ku, yi rikodin taƙaitawar mintuna 2, kuma rubuta shirinku na kwanaki 90.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Gina fakitin bincikenku da samfurin ƙarshe

Rubuta shirin ku na kwanaki 90, sannan ku ɗauki tambayoyin
